traits.name: Snake Search
traits.text: When the stheno harpist Searches or Seeks, their snakes try to help too, rolling a separate Perception check with a modifier of –1 instead of +4. If the snakes notice something, they try to notify the stheno, though they are no more intelligent than normal snakes and might find different things interesting than the stheno does.

traits.name: Speak With Snakes
traits.text: The stheno harpist can communicate with snakes, including the ones in their hair, and can use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on snakes and Request things from snakes. Items harp, leather armor, rapier, shortbow.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ rapier +7 (deadly d8, disarm, finesse); Damage 1d6 (1d6) piercing

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ shortbow +7 (deadly d10, range increment 60 feet, reload 0); Damage 1d6 (1d6) piercing
